patterns.key_values: translucent popover shell ~22pt radius, ~11pt padding; hero + 4-thumbnail strip + action bar stack; no traffic lights
light neutral vibrancy over live desktop; content (images) opaque; no glass-on-glass
4 equal rounded thumbnails ~14-16pt radius, ~10pt gaps, faint light-ring selection
bottom action bar: 3 borderless monochrome SF Symbols leading, 2 capsule actions trailing

signature_moves: Content-deferential monochrome chrome: refuses system accent — black primary capsule, white secondary, neutral selection, gray glyphs — so the wallpaper photo is the only saturated thing on screen (purposeful for a wallpaper picker; trade-off: overrides user's controlAccentColor)
Chromeless favorite heart floating directly on the hero image, no button background
Translucent popover material lets the live desktop bleed through — material as message ('this is about your screen')
defects: Iso-styled competing actions (mild) — two equal-size filled capsules (换张 white + 设为壁纸 black); native grammar/hierarchy want one prominent + one recessive; mitigated by black-vs-white contrast + correct trailing placement
Contrast Dilution risk — white attribution text over a variable photo with no scrim guarantee
Weak selection affordance — current-thumbnail ring is very low contrast and non-standard (not accent inset)

aesthetic.direction: content-deferential gallery chrome — neo-grotesque-product restraint (translucent neutral material + black/white capsules) applied to a consumer utility so imagery carries all color; loose density, soft large radii

psychology: Jakob's Law — honored: menu-bar-extra popover is a conventional, expected Mac surface for a background utility
Von Restorff / signal detection — desaturating all chrome makes the photo and the one red heart pop; but two co-primary filled buttons split the 'one different thing' at the action level
Hick's Law — honored: minimal decision load (shuffle / set + 3 utilities)
Fitts's Law — honored: large capsule targets and full-thumbnail hit areas
Aesthetic-Usability effect — polished translucent/rounded/photographic panel buys perceived usability on first contact
notes: Single surface, MARKETING COMPOSITE only (no raw app screenshots): popover floats over a deliberately-blurred green-foliage desktop; green panel cast is backdrop bleed through a light neutral vibrancy material, NOT an intrinsic color. Window scale unverifiable — all tokens (estimated)(inferred), assume ~@2x. Lineage native at med confidence (SF Symbols + vibrancy + capsule + menu-bar form factor; no web tells) but a well-built Electron/Tauri menu-bar app can't be fully excluded from one image. Era liquid-glass is INTENT (capsule bezels) — cannot confirm true Liquid Glass lensing vs. plain Big Sur vibrancy from a single light still. icon.png (robin on warm cream, Big-Sur squircle, illustrative) NOT scored per Workflow-A-only scope, but recorded as brand evidence: it is warm/characterful where the UI is cool/neutral — brand mark and chrome do not share a palette family.
